title: Birthday Bonus Make-Goods in Marlowe Rewards: Care Desk Reference
content:
## The rule

Sometimes a Marlowe Rewards birthday bonus does not post on its posting day because the tier then on record carried no birthday points. Such a bonus can be made good within the birth month. The member claims it in person, confirming the date of birth on the profile, and the claim posts it as a birthday bonus available at once. It posts only while both of these hold:

- the membership is in status active; and
- the membership was enrolled at least the tier's minimum birthday-bonus tenure, in calendar days, before the claim.

The birthday bonus is not posted until the membership carries the tier its tier-qualifying spend has reached under the tier rules.

Put another way: while the tier on the membership is not the tier its tier-qualifying spend has reached under the tier rules, the birthday bonus is not posted.

A birthday make-good is claimed at most once for each calendar year, the year being its bonus reference. It is never claimed for a year whose birthday bonus already stands on the ledger.

A birthday make-good is not a goodwill grant. It needs no delivery claim, and its bonus reference is the year, not a claim number.

## Invocation

`claim_birthday_bonus_8dc2d134` is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks it for the customer and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, confirming their own date of birth. Claiming books one bonus entry on the member's points ledger, dated and available today, under the given bonus kind and reference year, recorded at the tier the membership holds today. It adds the claimed points to the membership's points balance, and the member sees the bonus on their points history immediately.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `membership_id` | The member's own Marlowe Rewards membership number, as read out by the agent from the membership lookup |
| `customer_id` | The member's customer reference number on the profile, as read out by the agent from the customer lookup |
| `bonus_type` | The kind of bonus being claimed. It is exactly one of the values listed below |
| `bonus_reference` | The year the birthday bonus belongs to: always the YYYY form of the birth-month year |
| `birthday_points` | The birthday points claimed: a positive whole number, credited in signed whole points |

**Values of `bonus_type`:**

- `birthday`: the yearly birthday bonus. This is the only kind this claim is used for.
- `welcome`: the one-time enrolment bonus.
- `product_review`: a published product review.
- `referral`: a referred friend's first order.
- `service_goodwill`: compensation for a documented delivery failure.
- `not_applicable`: the entry is not a bonus at all.

**Stored formats of the bonus reference.**

| Bonus kind | Reference format |
|---|---|
| welcome | membership id |
| birthday | YYYY |
| product review | REV-####### |
| referral | customer id |
| service goodwill | claim id |
| entries that are not bonuses | empty |

## Return

The tool returns a one-line text receipt. It names the new bonus-entry reference, the whole points credited, the reference year, and the membership's whole-point balance afterwards. The receipt appearing means the bonus was credited.
